mapper.sql: id, title, summary, detail, category, category_name, image_url, location, start_time, end_time, capacity, registered_count, status, required_role_code, creator_id, reviewer_id, published_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: update activity set title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, detail = #{detail}, category = #{category}, category_name = #{categoryName}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, location = #{location}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, capacity = #{capacity}, required_role_code = #{requiredRoleCode} where id = #{id}
update activity set status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, published_at = case when #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' then current_timestamp else published_at end where id = #{id}
update activity set registered_count = registered_count + 1 where id = #{id} and status = 'PUBLISHED' and registered_count < capacity
